# Molt

> Molt is a Hugging Face-native, minimal, and scalable framework for agentic reinforcement learning:
> Ray for placement and queues, vLLM for rollout, NeMo AutoModel and FSDP2 for training.

Each link below is one page of the documentation, as a Markdown file.
The source code is at https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-molt.

## Start here

- [Installation](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/installation.md): The container, a local install, and the optional AutoModel-Slim backend.
- [Quick start](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/quick-start.md): A first RL run, a first SFT run, and the switches to reach for next.
- [Recipes](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/recipes.md): The launch scripts that ship with the repository.

## Build agents

- [Agent contract](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/agents.md): Env or ChatAgent, the Result fields, retries, and context compaction.

## Train

- [Algorithms](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/algorithms.md): Estimators, KL, the PPO critic, distillation, and adding your own.
- [Asynchronous training](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/async-training.md): The async switches, partial rollout, and the mismatch metrics.
- [IS correction](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/is-correction.md): Importance sampling for stale rollout log-probs, score centering, and the REINFORCE Zero recipe.
- [Evaluate and debug](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/evaluate-debug.md): Scoring a checkpoint, replaying a rollout batch, and metrics to watch.

## Scale

- [Scaling](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/scaling.md): TP, EP, and CP for the trainer and for the rollout engines.
- [MoE routing](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/moe-routing.md): Router precision, routing replay, and router freeze.
- [MTP rollout](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/mtp-rollout.md): Faster generation with speculative decoding.
- [LoRA](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/lora.md): Flags, target matching, learning rates, and the RL limits.

## Reference

- [RL flags](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/cli-rl.md): Every flag of molt.cli.train_rl_ray, generated from its parser.
- [SFT flags](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/cli-sft.md): Every flag of molt.cli.train_sft, generated from its parser.
- [molt.agents API](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/api-agents.md): The exported classes with their fields, methods, and docstrings.

## Project

- [Development](https://nvidia-nemo.github.io/labs-molt/guide/pages/development.md): Checking a change, regenerating the reference, and contributing.
